name: B10-0126/2025 (PPE) – Repression by the Ortega-Murillo regime in Nicaragua, targeting human rights defenders, political opponents and religious communities in particular
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on repression by the Ortega-Murillo regime in Nicaragua, targeting human rights defenders, political opponents and religious communities in particular
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns Nicaragua's government for jailing and exiling opponents, church leaders and journalists, and for shutting down thousands of civil society groups. It rejects the January 2025 constitutional changes, which it says give the government total power. It asks the European Union to monitor its own funds in Nicaragua, support exiled opponents, and widen sanctions to include President Ortega and his inner circle. It also calls for international criminal investigations. This is a statement of the Parliament's position, not a change in law.

- The European Union is asked to widen sanctions and check its funds in Nicaragua.
- It affects Nicaragua's government, its opponents, church groups and journalists.
- Next, the resolution goes to European Union institutions and Nicaraguan authorities.
